name: Apollo Portal Console
description: Manage Apollo 2.x configuration with independently authored pages and password login. Known visual parity gaps remain.
releaseNotes: 0.2.2 is the first Store update since 0.1.3. It exposes five MCP tools over the existing Apollo service API: read (apollo_read, apollo_session), write (apollo_write) and full-access administration (apollo_admin, apollo_authorize_consumer), while keeping the existing secret redaction, read-only and explicit-confirmation guards; manifest permissions are unchanged (host.storage only) and upgrading grants no access. It also removes the unsupported mcpTools Store metadata field that blocked release import. UI behavior is unchanged. A matching updated DBX Desktop and standalone MCP are required.

zh-CN.name: Apollo Portal 控制台
zh-CN.description: 独立编写 Apollo 2.x 管理页面，支持普通账号密码登录。全量页面及弹窗 1:1 对照仍有差距。
